capability: The two remaining XML documentation pointers to the pre-NVT-END-FLAG-1113-01 whole-image TryReadBackup overload are corrected to name the resolved-declaration overload, so a new consumer following IntelliSense is directed to the declared-position and Unresolved handling instead of a whole-image rescan
searchEvidence: docs/handoff/bugs/BUG-20260927-nvt-reader-doc-points-to-migration-overload.md: NVT-END-FLAG-1113-01 made the whole-image TryReadBackup(ReadOnlySpan{byte}, out FirmwareConfigMetadata[, out int]) overload migration-only, but two XML doc comments still tell runtime consumers to call the two-argument overload.

rg -n "cref=\"TryReadBackup|cref=\"FirmwareConfigMetadataReader.TryReadBackup" src: exactly two cref pointers to the two-argument overload exist in src/, both named by the bug: FirmwareConfigMetadataReader.cs:16 (TryReadAtAbsoluteAddress's doc) and FirmwareConfigVersionWritePlan.cs:67 (CreateFromCanonicalBackup's doc). No third stale pointer exists.

rg -n "TryReadBackup" --include=*.cs src: every production call site (CompositionRunService.FinalOutputValidations.cs, FirmwareConfigChipCountDiagnostics.cs, CompiledInputArtifactObservationService.cs, FirmwareArtifactClassificationResolver.CtrlRam.cs, BuiltInFirmwareInspection.cs, BuiltInFirmwareInspection.Metadata.cs) already passes a FirmwareNvtEndFlagResolution argument, matching tests/NvtFwCombiner.Architecture.Tests/RepositoryBoundaryTests.NvtEndFlagCallers.cs's NvtBackupReaderInventory and its UndeclaredBackupReadRegex assertion that no reader calls TryReadBackup without a declaration. No production consumer calls the two-argument or three-argument overload; this is a documentation-only defect, confirmed against the existing architecture test rather than by adding a new one.

The three-argument overload's own doc (FirmwareConfigMetadataReader.cs, TryReadBackup(ReadOnlySpan{byte}, out FirmwareConfigMetadata, out int)) already states 'Production code reads through a FirmwareNvtEndFlagResolution; this overload is deleted with the empty migration inventory.'; only the two-argument overload's own doc lacked an explicit migration-only marker before this record, even though it is the exact signature both stale pointers named.
semanticOwner: FirmwareConfigMetadataReader and FirmwareConfigVersionWritePlan remain the sole owners of these XML doc comments; NVT-END-FLAG-1113-01's resolved-declaration overload and its ADR 0076 semantics are unchanged.
terminalContract: No production behavior, byte, range, or public member signature changes. TryReadAtAbsoluteAddress's doc and FirmwareConfigVersionWritePlan.CreateFromCanonicalBackup's doc now cref TryReadBackup(ReadOnlySpan{byte}, FirmwareNvtEndFlagResolution, out FirmwareConfigMetadata, out int) instead of the two-argument overload. The two-argument TryReadBackup's own doc now states it is a migration-only whole-image compatibility read and names the same declaration overload for runtime use.

designReview.evidence: Bounded local R1 documentation-only correction of two stale XML doc cref pointers left over from the finalized NVT-END-FLAG-1113-01 record; no Application, profile, firmware byte, range, or contract change, and no production consumer calls the overload the stale docs pointed to.
